name: EventHistoryPage

states.name: Page Header and Identity
states.description: The page header establishes the Workflow Event History identity with a Radio icon, shows aggregate counts (event count, subscription count), and auto-refreshes data every 5 seconds.

states.name: Event Filtering

requiredElements.text: Filter by event name or source

states.description: A search/filter bar allows users to narrow down events by name pattern or source workflow. Essential when the event history is busy during multi-workflow orchestration.
states.precondition: At least one event exists but the filter excludes all of them

states.name: Durable Queue Status Dashboard
states.description: Compact widget displaying real-time state of the durable workflow queue. Data from GET /inngest/queue reflecting WorkflowQueue semaphore state and crash-recovery status. Backend: workflow_queue.rs, database/queue_ops.rs (SQLite + PG), main.rs (startup recovery).

states.name: Circuit Breaker Health Widget
states.description: Displays state of the global circuit breaker (orchestrator/retry.rs). Shows: state (Closed=green, Open=red, Half-Open=yellow), failure count vs threshold, cooldown. When Open, all retries are rejected. After cooldown, a probe request is allowed (Half-Open). Backend: CircuitBreaker in AppState, queried via GET /inngest/circuit-breaker from mcp/inngest.rs.

states.name: Event History Table
states.description: Reverse-chronological table of workflow events. Each row: timestamp, color-coded event name, source workflow, truncated data preview. Rows are expandable to show full JSON payload and metadata. Events emitted by workflow_event_bus.rs at lifecycle transitions in task_lifecycle.rs.
states.precondition: An event row has been clicked/expanded

states.name: Active Subscriptions Panel
states.description: Grid of active event subscriptions below the event table. Each card shows event pattern (monospace), green active dot, and 'once' badge. Subscriptions registered by trigger_system for WorkflowChain triggers. Polls GET /inngest/subscriptions every 15 seconds.
states.precondition: At least one subscription is registered

states.name: Empty, Loading, and Error States
states.description: The page handles edge cases: offline runner (yellow warning), API errors (red banner), loading (spinner message), empty history (centered icon + message). These ensure users always understand system state.
states.precondition: Runner is not running or unreachable

states.name: Navigation and Page Access
states.description: The Event History page is accessible from the main app navigation at /event-history. It should load independently without requiring other pages to be visited first.

states.name: Auto-Refresh and Data Freshness
states.description: All data auto-refreshes via polling through useRunnerQuery. Events + queue + circuit-breaker poll every 5s; subscriptions every 15s. Polling is deduplicated by shared API client.

description: Workflow Event History page -- the central observability hub for the Inngest-inspired workflow orchestration system. Displays a live-updating table of all workflow lifecycle events (completed, failed, started, step completed, verification passed/failed), a durable queue status dashboard showing pending/running/max-concurrent/max-depth with persistence indicator, a circuit breaker health widget showing open/closed/half-open state with failure count vs threshold, and active event subscriptions registered by the trigger system. Events are emitted by the Rust event bus (workflow_event_bus.rs) at task lifecycle transitions and consumed by the trigger_system for reactive WorkflowChain triggers. The page polls the MCP API endpoints GET /inngest/events, /inngest/subscriptions, /inngest/queue, and /inngest/circuit-breaker. Backend: mcp/inngest.rs (5 endpoints), workflow_event_bus.rs (pub/sub), database/queue_ops.rs (durable persistence), orchestrator/retry.rs (CircuitBreaker).
